description_en: Queries the cloud storage image lifecycle of an IPC device
description_zh: 调用该接口查询IPC设备的云存储图片生命周期
name: QueryDevicePictureLifeCycle

parameters.description_en:
The device ID of the IPC device. The ID issued by IoT Platform for the device, which is the unique identifier of the device.

You can call the [QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~) operation of IoT Platform to query the device ID.
parameters.description_zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。

可调用物联网平台[QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~)查询。
